race.comment: YES YOSHI (7) resumes. He's shown good ability last time in behind some smart ones, a horrible watch at Bendigo in a handy 3yo race when backed off the map but finding all sorts of trouble. Sets up well here and has the class to take it out. ELECTRIC ELVIS (5) continues to race very well, just nosed out at Seymour by a handy filly last time. Rock-hard fit and will roll forward, hard to knock. BALANCE (13) is a lightly raced mare with upside, just beaten at Pakenham Synthetic last time off a solid win fresh. Can continue to progress. CARDAMOM (10) resumes with a nice profile and did win well fresh at Cranbourne last time before testing a good one. Keeping safe.
